name: Crash and Error Reporting Foundation
notes: The user authorized continued source development, but the recorded v1.17 Step 2 Unity and device evidence is not retained and the Step 3 entry gate is not satisfied.
This is a detached pre-entry source candidate. Static checks do not prove Unity compilation, Test Runner execution, device behavior, or production readiness.

The public draft accepts only a closed reviewed enum catalog and bounded delivery state; caller-supplied strings, messages, stacks, exception objects, identifiers, arbitrary metadata, save data, purchase data, credentials, and unrestricted logs have no representation.

The buffer is bounded process memory only. It provides deterministic deduplication, timestamp-triggered hard retention, retry scheduling, and canonical inspection without file persistence or background work.
The public API cannot inject a transport. The shipped production path is disabled and the compiled network gate remains false.
No Unity log callback, runtime bootstrap, SDK, endpoint, credential, or provider binding is included.
All inherited package-lock, economy, commercial, cloud, Android-production, and publishing gates remain false.
